001: Ivan, do you like black coffee or with milk?
Honestly, I prefer it with milk. And you?
And I like it black, without sugar.
Really? Usually girls like it sweeter.
Well, I'm not like that. I like strong coffee more.
Then next time I'll treat you to some great black coffee.
002: Dmitry, do you like movies or theater more?
Probably theater. I like the actors' live performance more.
Wow, unexpected! And I never go to the theater at all.
I think it's boring and long.
Maybe you just haven't seen good productions. Want to go together?
003: Sergey, what kind of music do you usually listen to?
Mostly rock, and sometimes classical too.
Classical? Now that's unexpected for a rocker.
And what do you like, Elena?
I like pop music and jazz.
Jazz is great. I can recommend you a couple of good albums.
004: Honestly? Not really. I prefer ordering food.
And I love cooking, especially desserts.
Seriously? Then you're a dream girl.
Well, don't flatter me. Better tell me what you like to eat.
I like meat and pasta. And sweets — depends on my mood.
005: Olga, do you prefer relaxing at the sea or in the mountains?
At the sea, of course! I love warmth and sun.
And I'm closer to the mountains. There's fresh air and silence there.
But it's quiet at the sea too, especially in the evening.
I agree, but I still like the mountains more.
Fine, on vacation we'll go one at a time: first the sea, then the mountains.
006: Maria, do you like reading books or watching TV series?
I used to read a lot, but now I watch more and more series.
I get it, series are addictive. And which ones do you like?
I like detective stories and historical dramas.
Great choice! And I can't watch long series.
That's because you haven't found your genre. I'll recommend you something.
007: Anna, do you like winter or summer more?
Winter! I love snow, ice skating, and New Year.
Seriously? And I love summer because it's warm.
Well, in summer it's hot and stuffy. And in winter it's beautiful.
I won't argue, but in summer you can swim.
But in winter you can drink hot chocolate and watch the snow.
008: Dmitry, do you like sports or are you more into games?
I used to love football, but now I'm more into computer games.
I see. And I love swimming and yoga.
Yoga? That must be boring, I guess.
Not at all! It helps you relax and stay in shape.
Hmm, maybe I should try it. Will you sign me up for a class?
009: Sergey, do you like sweet or salty?
Salty, of course. Chips, nuts, cheese — that's my thing.
And I can't live without sweets.
That's bad for your figure, by the way.
I know, but sometimes I just really want something tasty.
Fine, then let's make a deal: you treat me to nuts, and I'll treat you to a chocolate bar.
010: Elena, do you like working in a team or alone?
I like working in a team more, it's more fun.
And I prefer working alone so nobody bothers me.
But together you can get the task done faster.
That's true, but I like doing everything my own way.
I understand. But sometimes it's worth trusting others — it's more interesting that way.
